findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived AWS credentials to anyone with describe/read permissions on the function, and they are also committed to source control.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime which is deprecated and no longer receives security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
No KMS key (kms_key_arn) is specified for encrypting environment variables, so sensitive values like the embedded credentials are not protected with a customer-managed key.
